headline: Messi calls prospect of facing Yamal in 2026 final crazy
summary: The Argentina captain reflects on a famous photo of him holding baby Lamine Yamal and vows to stop the Spanish prodigy from winning the World Cup.
details: Lionel Messi has described the possibility of facing Lamine Yamal in the 2026 FIFA World Cup final as "crazy," reflecting on an iconic photograph of the Barcelona prodigy as a baby in his arms.
Messi praised the 19-year-old Spain winger as one of the world's best players and a global icon, noting that Yamal is destined for greatness.
Despite his admiration, Messi stated that Argentina will try their best to ensure Yamal does not achieve a historic triumph in the final.
The Argentina captain also reflected on his own footballing journey, emphasizing that passion and a love for the game, developed in neighborhood teams, drove his career.
Messi discussed handling pressure, stating that he and his teammates view it as natural and focus on enjoying the game rather than the stress of a high-stakes match.
Argentina coach Lionel Scaloni also shared thoughts on a recent event, mentioning his interactions with Spain's Luis de la Fuente, describing the situation as surreal.
caption:
From holding him as a baby to potentially facing him in a World Cup final. Messi calls the journey "crazy."

Lionel Messi has described the possibility of facing Lamine Yamal in the 2026 FIFA World Cup final as "crazy," reflecting on an iconic photograph of the Barcelona prodigy as a baby in his arms.

Messi praised the 19-year-old Spain winger as one of the world's best players and a global icon, noting that Yamal is destined for greatness.

Despite his admiration, Messi stated that Argentina will try their best to ensure Yamal does not achieve a historic triumph in the final.

The Argentina captain also reflected on his own footballing journey, emphasizing that passion and a love for the game, developed in neighborhood teams, drove his career.

Messi discussed handling pressure, stating that he and his teammates view it as natural and focus on enjoying the game rather than the stress of a high-stakes match.

Argentina coach Lionel Scaloni also shared thoughts on a recent event, mentioning his interactions with Spain's Luis de la Fuente, describing the situation as surreal.

headline: Protests intensify as private university students join resistance
summary: The movement gains momentum as students from private universities enter the fray, adding a new dimension to the ongoing unrest.
details: Students from private universities have joined the ongoing protests, marking a new turn in the movement.
The resistance has expanded as students from various private institutions have started participating in the active demonstrations.
The influx of private university students has increased the scale and intensity of the movement across different locations.
The situation remains tense as the protests continue to grow in participation and scope.
